cards.name: Swamp Battleguard
cards.description: This creature is armed with a spiked club that can destroy almost anything in its path. Rumored to have a brother that is just as destructive.

cards.name: Flame Swordsman
cards.description: A fighter gifted with the power of fire. Attacks enemies with a sword that launches flames.

cards.name: Judge Man
cards.description: For this club-wielding warrior, there is no other outcome to battle than victory or defeat.

cards.name: Gaia the Fierce Knight
cards.description: A knight mounted on a horse that travels faster than the wind. His battle charge is a force to be reckoned with.

cards.name: Celtic Guardian
cards.description: An elf who learned to wield a sword, he baffles enemies with lightning-swift attacks.

cards.name: Karbonala Warrior
cards.description: A very average looking fighter with an unusually high attack factor.

cards.name: Kojikocy
cards.description: A man hunter with powerful arms that can crush boulders.

cards.name: Axe Raider
cards.description: An axe-wielding monster of tremendous strength and agility.

cards.name: Zanki
cards.description: Prefers to face enemies one-on-one. His swiftly drawn blade delivers a quick and immediate finish.

cards.name: Battle Warrior
cards.description: A warrior that fights with his bare hands.

cards.name: Kageningen
cards.description: Uses both physical and shadow forms to attack, making it a difficult creature to overcome.

cards.name: Hero of the East
cards.description: A samurai from the Far East armed with a razor-sharp sword.

cards.name: Supporter in the Shadows
cards.description: A cute elf that assists against enemies while remaining hidden from sight.

cards.name: Dream Clown
cards.description: The mysterious dance of this creature draws its enemies into eternal slumber.

cards.name: Ansatsu
cards.description: A silent and swift warrior specializing in sneak attack.

cards.name: Dragon Statue
cards.description: A granite warrior with a dragon's soul wields a powerful sword against all enemies.

cards.name: Monster Egg
cards.description: A warrior hidden within an egg that attacks enemies by flinging eggshells.

cards.name: Rhaimundos of the Red Sword
cards.description: A warrior armed with the sword of crimson flames. Uses fire to bind the movement of its enemies.

cards.name: Hard Armor
cards.description: A living suit of armor that attacks enemies with a bone-jarring tackle.

cards.name: M-warrior #1
cards.description: Specializing in combination attacks, this warrior uses magnetism to block an enemy's attack.

cards.name: M-warrior #2
cards.description: Specializing in combination attacks, this warrior is equipped with a tough, magnetically coated armor.

cards.name: The Judgement Hand
cards.description: The hand of final judgement is capable of intense attacks against the enemy.

cards.name: Mysterious Puppeteer
cards.description: A puppet master that manipulates enemies during battle.

cards.name: Armaill
cards.description: A strange warrior who manipulates three fearsome blades with both hands and its tail.

cards.name: Masked Clown
cards.description: A dancing warrior that makes mincemeat out of opponents with a sharp scythe.

cards.name: Eyearmor
cards.description: This warrior confuses and destroys enemies by adopting their image.

cards.name: Doron
cards.description: An unpredictable creature that splits in two and attacks the enemy from two opposite directions.

cards.name: Kagemusha of the Blue Flame
cards.description: Serves as a double for the ruler of the blue flame. A master swordsman that wields a fine blade.

cards.name: Trap Master
cards.description: A warrior that excels in laying traps such as a bottomless pit, for eternally ensnaring opponents.

cards.name: Fiend Sword
cards.description: Few have escaped the creature. Those that have done so have gained untold power.

cards.name: Skull Stalker
cards.description: Swift and vicious, this monster grabs its victim with its pincers and attack the captive with its poison stinger.

cards.name: Wood Clown
cards.description: An unpleasantly smiling creature that wields a scythe to avoid enemy blows.

cards.name: Beautiful Headhuntress
cards.description: A lovely swordmaster with some very agile moves.

cards.name: Wodan the Resident of the Forest
cards.description: A warrior that has long resided in the forest and enjoys the protection of Mother Nature.

cards.name: Guardian of the Labyrinth
cards.description: A warrior that guards the entrance to the netherworld.

cards.name: Vishwar Randi
cards.description: A woman warrior that serves the forces of darkness.

cards.name: Hyo
cards.description: An ice warrior whose slightest touch freezes an opponent.

cards.name: Dimensional Warrior
cards.description: A monster capable of creating dimensional rifts to trap its enemies.

cards.name: The Little Swordsman of Aile
cards.description: An elf warrior mounted on a huge lizard.

cards.name: Princess of Tsurugi
cards.description: A queen of swords that is virtually unequaled in her mastery of every blade to man.

cards.name: Unknown Warrior of Fiend
cards.description: The speed of this warrior creates an intense vacuum that can actually slice threw a monster's hide.

cards.name: Protector of the Throne
cards.description: A creature that protects the king's throne from usurpers.

cards.name: Moon Envoy
cards.description: A servant of the moon goddess, This warrior wields a pike with a spectacular crescent-shaped blade.

cards.name: Masaki the Legendary Swordsman
cards.description: Legendary swordmaster and a veteran of over 100 battles.

cards.name: Dragoness the Wicked Knight
cards.description: A warrior equipped with equipment fashioned from dragon scales.

cards.name: Sonic Maid
cards.description: A maiden that uses sound to her advantage. She wields a scythe that's shaped like a musical note.

cards.name: Kanan the Swordmistress
cards.description: A lady swordsman that floats like a butterfly and sings like a bee.

cards.name: Stuffed Animal
cards.description: A deceptively cute stuffed animal that bites.

cards.name: Millennium Shield
cards.description: A Millennium Item candidate that is said to block any powerful attack.

cards.name: Black Luster Soldier
cards.description: A powerful warrior with the same capabilities as the legendary Blue-eyes White Dragon.

cards.name: Wall Shadow
cards.description: An unusually fast monster that sweeps across walls to attack it enemies.

cards.name: Gate Guardian
cards.description: Sanga, Kazejin, and Suijin join to form a single, powerful monster.

cards.name: Monster Tamer
cards.description: A master of monsters that exercises control over several creatures.

cards.name: Swordstalker
cards.description: A monster formed by the vengeful souls of those passed away in battle.

cards.name: Giltia the D. Knight
cards.description: Armed with a soul-searing spear, this creature favors magic attacks.

cards.name: Swordsman from a Foreign Land
cards.description: An eastern warrior armed with a cursed sword.

cards.name: Beautiful Beast Trainer
cards.description: A rare female magic user armed with a vicious whip.

cards.name: Armed Ninja
cards.description: A blue ninja that attacks with a large sickle and spiked feet.

cards.name: D. Human
cards.description: Gifted with the power of dragons, This warrior wields a sword created from a dragon fang.

cards.name: Mushroom Man #2
cards.description: A fully grown Mushroom Man with an increased attack factor.

cards.name: Lava Battleguard
cards.description: This brother of Swamp Battleguard may not be powerful but is pretty good on defense.

cards.name: Oscillo Hero
cards.description: A strange warrior from another dimension.

cards.name: Empress Judge
cards.description: Empress of the Golden Kingdom. None may refuse her will.

cards.name: Greenkappa
cards.description: A creature that transforms into the image of its enemy and copies every offensive move.

cards.name: Warrior of Tradition
cards.description: A lady warrior drenched in the essence from a thousand battlefields

cards.name: Succubus Knight
cards.description: A vile warrior wizard adept at casting doom-dealing spells.

cards.name: Queen's Double
cards.description: Not very useful double of a queen.

cards.name: Invader of the Throne
cards.description: A scheming queen who covets the king's throne during his absence.

cards.name: Hibikime
cards.description: Confuses enemy monsters with noise that is harsh to the ears.

cards.name: Performance of Sword
cards.description: A warrior dancer with fancy dance steps.

cards.name: Hungry Burger
cards.description: Attracts hungry enemies with tasty aromas and eats them when they get close enough.

cards.name: Skull Guardian
cards.description: A guardian of the law that doesn't forgive cheating. Attacks enemies with its sword-like arms.

cards.name: Garma Sword
cards.description: A skilled warrior that wields six swords against opposing monsters.
